From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-14 09:12 PST
Subject: Proposal: New Headcount - Senior Runtime Engineer (Rust) - Infra/Platform

Hi team,

Im proposing a new headcount in Infra/Platform for a Senior Runtime Engineer focused on Rust-native optimizations (req: GH-2378). Rationale: we have two upcoming low-latency services (prefix caching + KV-store layers) that would benefit from someone who can own kernel-level improvements and CI for quantized builds. This hire should materially reduce per-token CPU spend for high-QPS customers and unblock a stack of infra reliability tickets.

Suggested level & comp:
- Role: Senior Runtime Engineer (L4/L5)
- Base range: $160,000 - $210,000
- Target total comp (incl. equity & bonus): $220k - $320k
- Preferred start: Q1 2027

Financials & budget code: please see attached comp_band_table.csv and completed HC_Request_Form.pdf. Headcount slot requested: new headcount slot HIR-2026-INF-07 (pending finance signoff).

Notes:
- We prefer a candidate with production Rust experience and background in GPU/CPU inference optimizations.
- Recruiting has a strong matched candidate in the pipeline (Emily Johnson via AdeptRecruit).

Ask: please confirm approval to open the req at L4 with flexibility up to the top of L4 band, and confirm any constraints on sign-on/relocation budget. If we get a greenlight today, recruiting can extend a firm timeline to the candidate and aim for an early Feb start.

Thanks,
Neha
Neha Kapoor
Director, Infrastructure & Runtime
Redwood Inference

Neha —

Thanks for the write-up. Approve in principle, subject to Finance confirming the budget and People Ops confirming the band/slot. A couple of quick questions:
- Is this role required on-site? If remote (EU) theres additional contractual complexity.
- Can you share the expected impact metrics (tokens/sec improvement, estimated cost reduction) for prioritization in the Q1 roadmap?

If recruiting already has a vetted candidate, please loop their resume + recruiter note and we can move fast. If Finance wants to hold, we can repurpose an existing bench slot but would prefer not to.

— Vivek

Folks,

Thanks — I reviewed the HC request and comp bands. Two things we need before I can formally approve HIR-2026-INF-07:
1) Full cost breakdown including on-target compensation, benefits load, recruiting fee or agency placement (if any), and expected first-year outflow. Please attach a 3-year cost view.
2) Confirm the requested band. I suggest opening at L4 midpoint to control budget; if hiring managers insist on L5 we need a business case tied to measurable performance deltas.

Also note: we generally limit sign-ons > $10k to exceptions approved by me. If you plan to offer a higher sign-on we need written justification.

Ive attached the comp_band_table.csv with current bands and a provisional salary cap adjustment (5% reduction at the top of band) until the FY budget is finalized.

Once I get the cost sheet, I can sign off on the slot.
